SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Brace yourself. Lunch is on me today.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Eh?

It's not a secret or anything, but I've been working 
part-time lately. Not only that, but it was also 
payday yesterday!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Okay then, what do you want to eat? Anything's 
fine, so don't hold back.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: A-Anything's fine with you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yep, anything!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hmmm... I wonder? Kyou-chan, are you sure?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Leave it to me! Just ask and ye shall receive!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...Anything's fine?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Of course! It's not like I can do this all the time, you 
know. I gotta act the part of a good boyfriend 
from time to time, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Wow~ Kyou-chan, you seem more reliable than 
ever today~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You mean today “as usual", right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ehehe, that’s right!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Kyou-chan, it's not too late for you to reconsider, 
you know? I don't mind...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, er, I mean... I was wondering what I should say 
to get you to take up my offer.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah. Don't worry about it. Come on, just tell me 
what food's on your mind?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...Is it really okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, it's all good.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hmm...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Then, maybe I will take up your offer?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: In any case, don't hold back. Because――

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ――Because what?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I just got my pay, and that means this is the only 
time to indulge in luxury.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
That's amazing, Kyou-chan~ You're so rich now, 
aren't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, I'm practically loaded now! Hahahaha!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
But this is the fruit of your hard work, surely you 
have something you want to get for yourself...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Something I want, huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That'd be Manami!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Eh? EH? Kyou-chan, what are you saying?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
All I want is you, you heard me! ...I'm not repeating 
that again.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: But... I'm already attached to Kyou-chan, aren’t I...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I would stay with you even if you didn't give me 
any money, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No no, I didn't mean it like that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I'm only working part-time in order to afford these 
experiences together.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I see...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: As of now, there is nothing I really want.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Really? Then why are you working part time?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I don't have any special reason, but if anything I'd 
say it's more to enjoy our time together.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Thank you, Kyou-chan. But you know, you don't 
need to force yourself to get a job just for that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I don't think I'm forcing myself too much. I'm doing 
this because I want to.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So, you don't have to worry about that.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Mm~ In that case, I would be happier if you save 
up a bit for the future.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hahaha, that's just like you, Manami.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Retirement is very important, Kyou-chan!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: More like utility bills.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So, have you decided on what you want to eat?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hmmmm~ Nothing comes to mind for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah, we probably got side-tracked for too long, 
huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Really though, I wonder what's good? Kyou-chan, 
can you decide for me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't have anything in mind either.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
In that case, I will just have whatever you're 
having!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Manami... It's my treat, so there would be no point if 
I made the decision, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
That's true. Still, I can’t just decide on such short 
notice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It'll be tough on me if you don't decide...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Mm~ I will just go with Kyou-chan’s 
recommendation.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I guess Kyou-chan doesn't have anything in mind 
either?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Come on... What's the point in me choosing?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
But I want to have what you're having too, you 
know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Even if you say that...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I'm not particular about food... I just like watching 
Kyou-chan eating happily.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You sure you're okay with that? No need to hold 
back at this point.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yup, I'm fine, really.

She's definitely being considerate here. I won't 
force it, but let her take some time to decide.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then, let's think about it together while we walk.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Um... Kyou-chan, you took the time to listen to me, 
and I... Sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
No need to apologize. I should've planned 
something before heading out.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Then again, such a sudden invitation does feel 
exciting and fun.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That's good to hear. It's a rare experience for us, 
so let's have a bit of fun?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Okay~

I took Manami's hand in mine and walked towards 
the train station.
